# Notices packed into the Android APK

Copies of the license texts of what `android/app/src/main/cpp/CMakeLists.txt` compiles into the APK. `android/app/build.gradle` packs them,
with the repository's `LICENSE`, the fonts' OFL files and the NDK's LLVM notice, and the launcher's Licencias screen shows them.

They are copied from the pinned versions of the dependencies. Update them when a dependency changes. `docs/android/LICENSES.md` lists what each one covers.
